users.create.description: Create one local account. Your current password confirms this high-impact change.
users.create.impact: Creates one enabled account with the selected role. It does not start a session for that user.
users.create.title: Create user
users.delete.blockedLabel: Cannot delete {name}, the last enabled administrator
users.delete.description: Review the permanent effect before deleting {name}.
users.delete.impact: Permanently deletes this local account and revokes every session and outstanding proof for it. This cannot be undone.
users.delete.title: Delete {name}?
users.edit.description: Review account fields and confirm the change for {name}.
users.edit.impact: A display-name-only change keeps sessions. Changing login name, role, or status revokes every session and outstanding proof for this user.
users.edit.title: Edit {name}
users.empty.body: Create a local user when another person needs access.
users.empty.title: No users returned
users.error.conflict: This record changed, or the last-administrator safety rule blocked the action. Reload the list and review it again.
users.error.forbidden: The current password was not accepted, or your access changed. Review and try again.
users.error.notFound: This user no longer exists. Reload the list.
users.error.passwordMismatch: The password confirmation does not match.
users.error.rateLimited: Too many attempts were made. Wait briefly, then try again.
users.error.session: Your session ended. Sign in again.
users.error.unavailable: The service could not complete this action. No success is assumed.
users.error.unexpected: The action could not be completed. No success is assumed.
users.error.validation: Check the entered values and try again.
users.field.currentPasswordHelp: Used once to authorize only this exact action.
users.lastAdministrator.safety: This is the last enabled administrator. Its administrator role and enabled status are locked, and it cannot be deleted.
users.loadError.body: The service could not return the current user list. No stale list is shown.
users.loadError.title: Users unavailable
users.loading.body: Reading the current local account list.
users.loading.title: Loading users
users.moreError: More users could not be loaded. The current rows remain unchanged.
users.reset.description: Set a replacement local password for {name}.
users.reset.impact: Replaces this user's password and revokes every session and outstanding proof. The user must sign in with the new password.
users.reset.title: Reset password for {name}
users.revoke.description: Sign {name} out of every local session.
users.revoke.impact: Revokes every session and outstanding proof for this user. The account, role, access status, and password stay unchanged.
users.revoke.title: Revoke sessions for {name}?
users.table.caption: Current local users
users.table.label: Local users
